title: Grateful Dead Live at Richfield Coliseum on 1990-09-08
source: Master Audience Recorded By Fitzy, Transfer By Keo; Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns > Sony D5; Tapes: Maxell XLII-s 90 *, Maxell MX 100; Microphones Set Up Upper seats Last Row Vince's Side Between Half And A Quarter Away From Stage; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1 > Korg MR-1000 @ 1 Bit/5.6 MHz; Tracking/Sample Rate Conversion With AudioGate V.3.02 To 32/96 kHz Wave; Dithered/Flacked With Korg Aqua To 16/44; SBE's Checked/Fixed With Trader's Little Helper; Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename

ai_review.summary: Ecstatic, triumphant Terrapin performance with a solid recording despite a tiny missing segue into Mystic Drum.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for an ecstatic and triumphant rendition of Terrapin Station, a commanding take on The Watchtower, and a fresh spin on the Ashes theme. Reviewers note only a very small gap in the segue to Mystic Drum that is virtually unnoticeable, resulting in an overall good‑quality fan tape.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed 5‑star review highlights an outstanding performance with only a minor recording glitch; the strong show outweighs the modest technical issue.

recording_quality.technical_notes: A tiny missing segment in the segue to Mystic Drum is noted, but otherwise the tape sounds clear and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert builds an ecstatic, triumphant mood; the only hiccup is a barely‑noticeable gap before Mystic Drum, but the overall flow remains strong.
